title: Uruguayan Pumpking Fry
description: A sweet and savory combination of pumpkin and Uruguayan spices. A perfect side dish for a chilly evening.
instructions: Toss the pumpkin cubes with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large skillet, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook for 3-4 minutes, until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the Uruguayan stir fry spice blend and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the roasted pumpkin cubes to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion and spice mixture.
Sprinkle the velvety brown sugar over the top and stir to combine.
